data.standardized_narrative: At 31 December 2022 the reported prior-year gross reserve movement was a small favourable development (approx. a $4.2m release) driven primarily by development on the 2020 underwriting year. This modest release occurred against a backdrop of significant catastrophe activity (notably Hurricane Ian in 2022 and Winter Storm Uri and Hurricane Ida in 2021) and an explicit allowance for elevated claims inflation (an uplift of 2.9% or $16.9m applied to net technical provisions). The dominant line affected is property (homeowners/high net worth personal lines), with other classes (motor, marine/yacht, liability) forming smaller parts of the portfolio.

data.data_quality_notes: Prior-year development was calculated from the gross claims development triangle (gross earned ultimate losses by underwriting year) where only 2020 is an extractable prior underwriting year; the report does not provide an explicit labelled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' gross figure. The exact_reserve_text is a short tabular phrase rather than a full explanatory sentence. The triangle is limited to UW years 2020-2022; RITC distortions are not indicated. All monetary values are in the report's native currency (USD). LOB-level reserve movements are not disclosed, so per-LOB amounts are null and directional assignments are low-confidence inferences.
